thread:
OpsBot: paging: PAGER: high-request-queue-length on inference-proxy in us-west-2. severity=page, svc=inference-proxy, queue_len=324, threshold=200
Maya (oncall): saw the page, jumping in. grabbing logs now.
Maya (oncall): @jon r can you help validate whether this is a spike from a customer test or real traffic?
Jon R: on it. checking request ids in the trace sampling, and flow through the router.
Ali: I see a backlog on the async worker pool, looks like a sudden increase in batch size during a 30s window -> batching didn't throttle.
Maya (oncall): mitigation: lowering max_batch_size and temporarily increasing worker replicas. doing `kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-worker --replicas=8`
Maya (oncall): ops command run, waiting for pods to come up.
infra-bot: scale request accepted: deploy/inference-worker -> 8 replicas. rollout in progress.
Jon R: traces show a particular client (ip/anon) sending high-throughput inference requests with long prompt prefixes. probably a misconfigured test.
Nina: opened a short-term route to move that client to a lower-priority class (rate-limited) to keep the rest healthy. applied routing rule: `client_id =~ "test-run-.*" -> route=low-priority`
Sam: reduced batch_size and enabled prefix-kv-cache bypass for that route to reduce memory pressure.
Maya (oncall): queue dropped from 324 -> 42 after scale + routing. current error rate steady. marking as mitigated.
OpsBot: incident status changed: mitigated. pages suppressed.
Maya (oncall): ok we need a follow-up: this caused noisy alerting and a couple of oncall wakeups. planning an alert-tuning + dashboard add for postmortem.
Ali: +1. Current alert that fired is `inference.queue.len > 200 for 2m`. we should consider smoothing or dynamic thresholds based on replica count and recent p50/p95 latency.
Jon R: Also want a dashboard panel for per-route batch size and per-client queue contribution. right now we only have cluster-wide queues, that's why it blasted the channel.
Nina: Suggest panels: 1) golden signals row (p50/p95 latency, error rate, throughput) 2) queue length heatmap by route 3) long-tail latency histogram 4) batch-size distribution over time 5) KV cache hit/miss 6) current replica counts and autoscaler activity 7) drilldown link to traces for spikes.
Maya (oncall): can someone put together a quick Grafana layout for the retro? we want to use it in the post-incident review and for runbook edits. Need drilldowns to traces and the sample request ids that dominated the queue.
Ali: I'll start a draft dashboard (templated) — will include variables: region, route, client_id. will wire panel drilldowns to Jaeger traces and to the request-log viewer.
Sam: let's also add an explainer panel listing suggested alert-tuning changes: - change static threshold to `> 90th percentile(queue_len/replicas)` - add a smoothing window of 3m - add a suppression for known test-client patterns
Jon R: for the golden signals row, recommend these metrics and thresholds (initial proposal):
```
- p50 latency < 150ms, p95 < 800ms, error rate < 0.5%
- throughput: baseline +/- 30% alerts for sudden drops/spikes
- queue/cpu saturation: alert when queue_len_per_replica > 150 OR cpu > 80% for 3m
```
Maya (oncall): sounds good. keep thresholds conservative for now, we can tune after a week of data.
Nina: also adding a 'noise meter' panel showing number of alerts triggered per day by inference.* to help assess if tuning reduces noise.
Maya (oncall): assigning follow-ups:
- Ali: draft Grafana dashboard + panels + jq export of interesting request ids -> due EOD tomorrow
- Jon R: add trace drilldowns and adjust runbook steps for routing misconfigs -> due in 48h
- Nina: prepare alert tuning PR with proposed thresholds and suppression rules -> due in 24h
- Sam: add a small alert to detect test-client bursts (regex match) so we can auto-route or suppress in future -> due in 48h

Ali: starting dashboard draft now. will post link when ready.
Jon R: will also add a panel showing autoscaler events correlated with queue spikes.
Maya (oncall): thanks all — we'll include this in the incident retro tomorrow. moving to post-incident channel and closing this oncall thread. :white_check_mark:
OpsBot: incident archived: 2234567890 - mitigation confirmed.
Maya (oncall): FYI for the retro: include screenshots of the new panels and an example of the drilldown flow (queue -> trace -> request body). helps PMs and SREs understand impact.
Sam: noted. I'll add a sample gif of the drilldown interaction.
Ali: draft pushed: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/ftY3x1e/inference-pager-runway (preview). feedback welcome.
Nina: reviewed the draft, left comments on two panels: 1) label p95 as server-side only, 2) add threshold lines to queue heatmap.
Maya (oncall): great. final step: update runbook with new mitigation: route test-clients to low-priority, reduce default max_batch_size during sustained increases, and who to page at each threshold.
Jon R: will PR runbook after lunch.
Maya (oncall): thanks team. wrapping up.
